title: Variety Effects in Mobile Advertising
eligible_reason: No difference-in-differences design. Effect of a continuous ad-variety measure on next-ad click-through, identified from quasi-random ad assignment within sessions.
design_notes: Impression-level data from a mobile in-app ad network; treatment is a continuous variety index of prior ads in the session, not a binary adoption. No staggered adoption dates.
estimators_reported: regression models exploiting quasi-experimental ad assignment
screener_notes: Text-only screen. No package_dir. Data come from a leading Asian mobile in-app ad network (proprietary).
